"Agent rapidly created and published by an unapproved maker",
"Native",
"exact",
"PowerPlatformAdminActivity",
"Requires validated observed BotId payload, a UPN-valued ActorName, environment ID and event UID, but not inventory registration. Inventory is left-joined for Registered/Unknown status only; missing inventory watchlist remains a setup failure. Different creator/publisher, missing fields, partial successes and failed operations are excluded. Approval is evaluated at query time, not historical event time. Exact event linkage is not malicious intent; no ATT&CK tactic asserted.",
"Registered agent authentication configuration changed",
"Native",
"configuration",
"PowerPlatformAdminActivity",
"Operation name alone cannot establish old/new authentication mode, weakened controls or an attacker. Requires BotId in validated Properties or PropertyCollection object and event UID. ActorUPN is empty when ActorName is not a UPN. No ATT&CK tactic asserted.",
"Permission assignment audit targets a registered agent identity",
"Native",
"configuration",
"AuditLogs",
"Known object ID match is required; never matches display name or app ID to an object ID. TargetResources may include resource and client principals: targeting does not identify the grantee or prove risky permissions. Validate audit target shape and operation spelling locally. No privileged scope classification or ATT&CK tactic asserted.",
"Registered agent identity signs in after a permission audit",
"Native",
"heuristic",
"AuditLogs, AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs",
"Uses exact service-principal object ID and bounded time, but audit targeting may mean resource rather than grantee. Sign-in proves authentication only, not use of the new permission, API access, sensitive-data access or escalation. ActorUPN refers to the audit initiator, not the signing-in service principal. Managed identity sign-ins are not covered.",
"Registered agent runtime spawns a shell with network activity",
"Native",
"heuristic",
"DeviceProcessEvents, DeviceNetworkEvents",
"Device ID plus case-insensitive exact parent filename/path identifies a configured runtime, not a proven agent session. Child/network linkage additionally requires PID and exact creation time to avoid PID reuse. Covers selected direct Windows shell children only; ordinary administrative tools can trigger. A connection does not prove exfiltration. Execution tactic maps observed shell execution, not a verified attack.",
"Registered agent runtime contacts a new non-allowlisted destination",
"Native",
"heuristic",
"DeviceNetworkEvents",
"Requires nonempty valid enabled allowlist per agent, hostname-bearing RemoteUrl, and baseline observations on three distinct days. Recent window is one hour; baseline is earlier observations within 14 days, not first-ever access. Hostname equality only, no suffix/wildcard approval. Does not cover IP-only events, prove data transfer, or claim MDE observes arbitrary file reads. No ATT&CK tactic asserted.",
"Optional: injection signal followed by a successful agent action",
"Optional",
"heuristic",
"AIAgentEvent_CL",
"Not native Microsoft telemetry. Requires schema 1.0 contract and producer-guaranteed unique sessions and immutable event IDs. Ordered session association does not prove prompt influence or malicious action. Blocked, failed and unknown actions are excluded; equal timestamps cannot establish order. No ATT&CK mapping inferred for prompt injection.",
"Optional: sensitive-data access followed by a non-allowlisted tool submission",
"Optional",
"heuristic",
"AIAgentEvent_CL",
"Not native telemetry. Requires trusted classifications, a nonempty correlation ID linking the trace, tool name, canonical destination hostname and an enabled per-agent allowlist. Excludes blocked/failed/unknown operations. Shared trace does not prove the submitted bytes contain the accessed data or establish exfiltration; no ATT&CK tactic asserted."
